label: ollama
note: Offline mode: scripts/start-ai.sh (LLM_PROVIDER=ollama, qwen3:1.7b + nomic-embed-text, CPU only); budget 150 s (local profile). Same code as the anthropic report.
method: Wall-clock latency of POST /api/chat (demo bearer token), fresh session per latency request, user_id cliente1988, 5 s pause before each request. cold = all Ollama models unloaded before each request; warm = models resident. Latency mean/p95 use llm_complete responses only; fallbacks and errors are not successes.
outcome_definition:
llm_complete | fallback_budget | fallback_error | http_error.

    Only llm_complete counts as success: every model step the route needs ran
    and returned a valid result. Deterministic policy outcomes (clarification,
    handoff, safety) after a successful contextual model call are complete.
